semantics.keep_driving: 1 exactly when arrived is 0 and gas_tank_empty is 0; otherwise 0
semantics.timing: Outputs reflect current inputs after combinational settling; no clock or cycle latency
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior
semantics.initialization: No stored state or explicit initialization; defined binary inputs determine outputs
semantics.bug_fix: Assign both outputs on all paths to eliminate inferred latches

numeric.arithmetic: No addition, subtraction, zero flag, rounding, saturation, or overflow; only conditionals and single-bit complement
numeric.input_domain: All eight binary input combinations; X/Z behavior not specified by the problem

verification.oracle: Independent truth table: shut_off_computer follows cpu_overheated; keep_driving truth table for arrived/gas_tank_empty is 00:1, 01:0, 10:0, 11:0
verification.coverage: Exhaust all eight binary combinations and all 64 ordered input transitions, checking outputs after settling to catch retained values
verification.tools: Icarus Verilog v12, -g2012, explicit dev_tb top and matching vvp; finite timeout for each compile/simulation
verification.pass: Self-checking comparisons with fatal mismatch and explicit PASS marker

specification_ambiguities.issue: Introductory sentence calls this an adder-subtractor with a zero flag, but the code contains only Boolean controls
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Use the supplied TopModule interface and control behavior; add no arithmetic ports or behavior

specification_ambiguities.issue: Missing else assignments do not explicitly state defaults
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Infer false defaults from control meanings: do not shut off a cool CPU and do not keep driving after arrival
